desc.zh: 把同一个借款人一年、两年……十年的利率连成一条线，新闻说它“倒挂了”“陡峭了”“预示衰退”。这篇从零息债券讲起，一步步拆出远期利率、预期和期限溢价，再讲久期、凸性、曲线的三种动法和倒挂的成因，接着走到公司债：违约概率、回收率、信用利差和垃圾债的违约为什么扎堆，最后是 2022–2026 年这条曲线的真实经历。十二个可以动手的模型，只讲机制，不是投资建议。
desc.en: Line up one borrower's one-, two- … ten-year interest rates and you get a curve the news calls “inverted”, “steepening” or “a recession signal”. Starting from zero-coupon bonds, this essay separates forward rates, expectations and the term premium, then covers duration, convexity, the three ways a curve moves and why it inverts, and moves on to corporate bonds: default probability, recovery, credit spreads and why junk-bond defaults cluster, ending with what the curve actually did in 2022–2026. Twelve hands-on models; mechanisms only, not investment advice.

title.zh: 同一条曲线，两种读法：预期和期限溢价为什么分不开
title.en: One curve, two readings: why expectations and the term premium cannot be told apart

desc.zh: 用一年一格的预期路径加期限溢价搭出曲线，再换一个期限溢价假设从同一条曲线读出另一条预期路径：只看曲线分不出谁对。
desc.en: Build a curve from a year-by-year expected path plus a term premium, then read a different path off the same curve under another premium: the curve alone cannot say which is right.

zh: 预期和期限溢价能分开吗
同一条收益率曲线两种解释
en: can you separate expectations from the term premium

title.en: Holding-period return, roll-down and the forward as break-even

desc.zh: 曲线按远期走，长债和短债回报一样；1962 年以来 10 年期零息国债的真实超额回报。
desc.en: If the curve follows the forwards, long and short bonds earn the same; the realised excess return of the ten-year zero since 1962.

en: is the forward rate a forecast

title.zh: ACM 与 Kim–Wright：期限溢价的两种估计
title.en: ACM and Kim–Wright: two estimates of the term premium

desc.zh: 期限溢价看不见，只能用模型估；1990–2026 年两个官方模型的估计和它们的分歧。
desc.en: The term premium cannot be observed, only estimated; two official models' estimates for 1990–2026 and where they differ.

zh: 期限溢价为什么是负的
en: why can the term premium be negative

title.zh: 凸性、免疫与哑铃型组合

desc.zh: 久期匹配负债能对冲平移；哑铃凸性大，平移占便宜，曲线一扭就吃亏。
desc.en: Matching a liability's duration hedges parallel moves; a barbell's extra convexity gains on shifts and loses on twists.

title.zh: 曲线的三种动法：水平、斜率、曲率

desc.zh: 主成分分析：三个形状解释几乎全部变动；Nelson–Siegel 用三个数画一整条曲线；牛陡熊陡的说法。
desc.en: Principal components: three shapes explain nearly all moves; Nelson–Siegel draws a whole curve with three numbers; bull and bear steepening.

title.zh: 倒挂是降息预期还是期限溢价太低
title.en: Is an inversion rate-cut expectations or a low term premium?

desc.zh: 用 ACM 把 10 年减 1 年拆成预期和期限溢价；2022–2025 年倒挂的起止日期。
desc.en: Splitting the ten-minus-one-year spread into expectations and term premium with ACM; the dates of the 2022–2025 inversion.

en: why does the yield curve invert
does an inverted yield curve always mean recession

title.zh: 信用利差：违约概率 × 违约损失
title.en: Credit spread: default probability × loss given default

desc.en: The credit triangle; historical default losses explain only part of market spreads: the credit spread puzzle.

title.en: Ratings, junk bonds and clustered defaults

desc.en: The investment-grade line; S&P default rates by rating; the Vasicek model of why defaults come in waves.

title.zh: 2022–2026 年：倒挂、解除倒挂与美债收益率上涨
title.en: 2022–2026: inversion, un-inversion and rising Treasury yields

desc.en: Why long rates rose after the Fed began cutting: mostly term premium per ACM and Kim–Wright; supply, inflation risk and r* as explanations.
